### Grok 4.5 | Aug 2026 | tutorial Summary
## Chinese
本教程為2019年4月29日Samsung SEA Product Experience於UX Global Meet舉辦的「User Research Experience Sharing Workshop」（版本1.0）。核心架構將「設計思維」（2009年前）與「研究思維」（2009年後）並列，強調兩者共同指導可用性與產品體驗研究協議，並提供專家評審與啟發式評估框架。
設計思維部分回溯2001–2008年前智慧多模態UX「考古」，作為2018/2019智慧顯示互動設計的歷史平行。關鍵原則包括「彈性注意力」（基於Kahneman，兼顧任務專注與環境分配）與「最小注意力」（介面退入背景，操作成為自動、無思過程）。圖示顯示單一模態造成注意力尖峰，多模態則均勻分配資源。引用Csikszentmihalyi的「心流」作為用戶沉浸體驗核心，並討論語音啟用與多模態整合。Donald Norman《未來事物的設計》規則被列出：為智慧機器提供自然訊號、可預測性、概念模型；機器則應保持簡單、給予理由、讓人感覺掌控。
研究思維轉向可證偽與可測量導向，引用Popper可證偽性、Galileo「使不可測者可測」與Kahneman對不確定性的警示。強調ISO 20282量化可用性測試（建議N≥50）與ISO 18529以人為本設計過程（需求識別→情境→需求→解決方案→評估的循環）。研究優先關注任務流、注意力分配與可用性，美學居次。教程以協作設計練習結束，並警示數字可能誤導、主動與被動方法差異。整體呈現從直覺原型迭代到實證、可證偽協議的方法論演進，總結多模態如何在行動環境中優化注意力資源。
## English
This tutorial is the version 1.0 workshop materials from the 2019 UX Global Meet “User Research Experience Sharing Workshop,” presented by Samsung SEA Product Experience on 29 April 2019. It frames two complementary modes of thinking: Design Thinking (pre-2009) and Research Thinking (post-2009). Both are positioned as guides for developing usability and product-experience research protocols and as frameworks for expert review and heuristic evaluation.
The Design Thinking section offers an “archaeology” of pre-smart multi-modal UX from 2001–2008, presented as a historical parallel to 2018/2019 smart-display interaction design. Central principles are Flexible Attention (drawing on Kahneman’s Attention & Effort: focused/selective attention for the task versus divided attention to the changing environment) and Minimal Attention (the interface should recede into the background so that interaction becomes automatic and effortless, especially in mobile settings). Diagrams illustrate how single-modal (display-only or audio-only) interfaces produce attention spikes, while multi-modal designs distribute load more evenly across time and sensory channels. Csikszentmihalyi’s concept of Flow—intense emotional involvement and timelessness—is advanced as the key to “user nirvana.” Speech enablement and multi-modal integration are briefly treated, and Donald Norman’s 2007 Design of Future Things supplies two sets of rules: those for human designers of smart machines (rich natural signals, predictability, conceptual models, continual awareness without annoyance) and those that machines themselves should follow (simplicity, reasons, sense of user control, continual reassurance, never labeling human behavior as “error”).
Research Thinking shifts emphasis toward falsifiability and quantification. Quotes from Popper (scientific statements must be falsifiable), Galileo (“measure what can be measured and make measurable what cannot”), and Kahneman underscore the necessity of acknowledging uncertainty. Concrete methodological anchors include ISO 20282 (test methods for quantifying consumer-product usability, recommended N ≥ 50) and the ISO 18529 human-centered design process (iterative cycle of identifying need, specifying context of use, specifying requirements, producing design solutions, and evaluating). Priority is given to task flow, attention allocation, and usability; aesthetics and look-and-feel are secondary. The workshop includes a collaborative design exercise that deliberately dispenses with PowerPoint, and it repeatedly cautions that “numbers can be deceiving” and that active versus passive methods yield different insights.
Taken together, the materials trace a methodological evolution from iterative physical prototyping and walkthroughs toward more formalized, falsifiable, measurement-oriented research protocols, while retaining the phenomenological insight that effective multi-modal design must manage the scarce resource of human attention in real environments.

## Chinese
### Grok 4.5 | Aug 2026 | Wissen
- 核心先驗：波普爾可證偽性原則——科學陳述必須可被反駁，否則不關涉實在；伽利略「使不可測者可測」構成測量優先的認識論起點。
- 證據更新路徑：從2009前設計思維（迭代原型、走查、主客觀指標）轉向2009後研究思維，納入ISO 20282量化可用性（N≥50）與ISO 18529成熟度模型。
- 方法論演進：主動／被動方法對比、數字可欺性警示，顯示先驗從直覺經驗轉向可證偽的實證協議。
- 可證偽結構：研究協議必須產出可被反證的可用性主張，否則僅為非科學陳述。
#### Wissen（知識論 / Popper / Bayes）
- 文稿呈現一種「以可量化性對抗不確定性」的知識結構：ISO 標準、PLS 回歸、物理鍵參數等皆被視為可反覆驗證的核心前提，形成研究者的基本 prior。
- 證據更新方式是「由多階段實測逐步修正假設」：紙本原型 → 實體鍵盤 → 虛擬鍵盤，構成一種 Bayes 式的累積式收斂，而非一次性定論。
- 可否證性體現在「拒絕單一指標」：主觀滿意度與客觀速度／錯誤率並置，使任何單一解釋都保持可被推翻的開放性。
#### AI Experts（Meta-Synthesis & Blind Spots）
三分頁的辯證結構為：以現象學處理注意力，以知識論處理不確定性，以解構處理技術邊界。心理動力是「以方法論維持世界的可預測性」。
- LLM 可能因訓練偏好而過度強化文本中的科學化語氣。
- 無法完全重建 1990s–2000s 手機產業內部的研發文化節奏。
- 對早期美國與韓國跨國 UX 團隊的權力結構理解有限。
## English
### Grok 4.5 | Aug 2026 | Wissen
- Core prior: Popperian falsifiability—scientific statements must be refutable or they do not speak of reality; Galileo’s “make measurable the unmeasurable” sets measurement as epistemic foundation.
- Evidence-updating path: Pre-2009 design thinking (iterative prototyping, walkthroughs, objective/subjective metrics) shifts post-2009 to research thinking via ISO 20282 quantified usability (N≥50) and ISO 18529 maturity model.
- Methodological evolution: Active vs. passive methods and “numbers can be deceiving” mark the move from intuitive experience to falsifiable empirical protocols.
- Falsifiability structure: Research protocols must generate usability claims open to refutation; otherwise they remain non-scientific statements.

## Chinese
### Grok 4.5 | Aug 2026 | Deconstruct
- 內部悖論：可證偽性與「數字可欺」並置，同時召喚「Flow」作為不可測的「用戶涅槃」，測量先驗自我瓦解。
- 結構空隙：2001–2008「考古」僅留下原則殘片，實際失敗痕跡、用戶聲音與非成功案例皆被抹除，形成空洞譜系。
- 平滑／條紋空間：注意力資源圖示將流動經驗條紋化為任務步驟與尖峰，同時宣稱多模態可恢復平滑分配，兩者互相解構。
- 缺失痕跡：介面「退入背景」的理想留下不可見的操作痕跡，主體自動性成為被書寫卻永不在場的缺席中心。
### Copilot Pro | Aug 2026 | Deconstruct
#### Deconstruct（解構 / Derrida / Deleuze）
- 文稿的技術敘述表面上追求「可測量、可驗證、可標準化」，但其深層結構卻依賴大量不可測的前提：注意力、流、使用者行為的「自動化」皆是無法完全量化的差異（différance），卻被當作穩定基礎。
- 研究流程被呈現為線性（ISO → 原型 → PLS → 建議），但文本內部充滿非線性跳躍：紙本原型與高階統計並置、心理物理與企業 KPI 混雜，形成 Deleuze 式的「條狀空間中夾帶平滑空間」。
- 「使用者」在文本中既被視為可測量的對象，又被宣稱「永遠是對的／不一定對」；此自我矛盾揭露了 UX 科學化敘事的內在裂縫：它必須同時依賴使用者，又必須否定使用者的主觀性以維持方法論的權威。
#### AI Experts（Meta-Synthesis & Blind Spots）
三分頁的辯證為：現象學處理注意力、知識論處理不確定性、解構揭露方法論的裂縫。心理結構是一種「在秩序與混亂之間維持張力」的研究者心態。
- LLM 可能因 alignment 訓練而過度強化文本的邏輯一致性，弱化其內在矛盾。
- 無法完全重建 2000s 手機產業中韓美跨國團隊的權力不對稱。
- 對早期香港科技文化（報導語氣、工程師幽默、BBS 語境）的細微語用差異理解有限。
## English
### Grok 4.5 | Aug 2026 | Deconstruct
- Internal paradox: Falsifiability and “numbers can be deceiving” coexist with “Flow” as unmeasurable “user nirvana,” collapsing the measurement prior upon itself.
- Structural gap: The 2001–2008 “archaeology” retains only principle fragments; actual failure traces, user voices, and non-success cases are erased, producing a hollow genealogy.
- Smooth/striated space: Attention diagrams striate lived flow into task steps and spikes while claiming multi-modal redistribution restores smoothness—each undoes the other.
- Missing trace: The ideal of interface “receding into background” leaves invisible operational traces; subject automaticity becomes the written-yet-absent center.
### Copilot Pro | Aug 2026 | Deconstruct
#### Deconstruct (Post‑Structural / Derrida / Deleuze)
- The document’s surface commitment to measurement and standardization masks a reliance on unquantifiable foundations: attention, flow, and “automaticity” function as différance—indeterminate elements treated as stable anchors.
- Although the research narrative claims linearity (ISO → prototypes → PLS → guidelines), its internal structure is non‑linear: paper mockups coexist with advanced statistics, psychophysics with corporate KPIs, forming Deleuzian striated space perforated by smooth space.
- The “user” is simultaneously positioned as authoritative (“always right”) and unreliable (“not always right”), exposing a structural contradiction in UX scientization: it must depend on user subjectivity while discrediting it to preserve methodological authority.
#### AI Experts（Meta-Synthesis & Blind Spots）
Across tabs, the dialectic is: phenomenology for attention, epistemology for uncertainty, deconstruction for methodological rupture. The psychological stance is a researcher maintaining tension between order and instability.
- Alignment training may over‑stabilize contradictions in the text.
- Limited ability to reconstruct asymmetric power dynamics in 2000s Korea–U.S. tech R&D.
- Partial grasp of early Hong Kong tech‑culture pragmatics and BBS‑era humor.

- 對齊偏誤：當代LLM安全訓練傾向強化「以用戶為中心」的正面框架，可能淡化「數字可欺」與不可測性之間的尖銳悖論。
- 文化限度：文件中前智慧多模態經驗的香港／亞洲脈絡細微差異，需人類現場記憶補充，模型無法獨立還原。
### Copilot Pro | Aug 2026 | AI Experts
#### Meta‑Synthesis（跨分頁總結）
- 在 _Epoché_、_Wissen_、_Interpret_、_Deconstruct_ 四個分頁中呈現的核心辯證，是一種研究者長期心態的三段式運作：以現象學管理注意力的流動、以知識論管理不確定性、以解構揭露方法論與技術敘事的裂縫。
- 整體心理結構是一種「在混亂中維持可控性」的技術研究者姿態：方法論既是工具，也是自我敘事；標準化既是秩序，也是遮蔽；使用者既是權威，也是矛盾來源。
#### Blind Spots（模型盲點）
- Alignment 訓練偏好邏輯一致性，使我可能弱化文本內部的矛盾、張力與歷史性語氣。
- 對 1970s–1990s 香港教育文化、報導語氣、早期 BBS 社群的互動節奏無法完全重建。
- 對韓美跨國科技企業（2000s）內部權力結構、語言層級與研發文化的細節理解有限。
## English
### Grok 4.5 | Aug 2026 | AI Experts
Across Epoché, Wissen and Deconstruct the structural-psychological dialectic is the tension between falsifiable measurement protocols and unmeasurable “Flow” experience, producing a double inscription that simultaneously striates and smooths subjective attention; archaeological fragments erase failure traces, allowing the epistemic prior to deconstruct itself.
- Model blind spot: Training corpora lack 2019 Samsung SEA workshop live dynamics and non-public prototype iteration data, preventing assessment of actual evidence-updating strength.
